name: Vintage Photo Frame Magnet
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a decorative gold plastic frame and magnetic backing, offering a vintage, elegant, and eye-catching display finish.
    - Features an ornate antique-style frame design that adds a classic and luxurious touch to photos and small artworks.
    - Includes a paper insert with 1-sided printing, allowing personalized photo or artwork display inside the frame.
    - Comes with a matching gold iron stand for flexible tabletop display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Frame options:
              +) Oval 1: 
                                → Overall size: 9.7 x 12 cm ~ 3.82 x 4.72 in
                                → Inner photo size: 5.4 cm x 7.4 cm ~ 2.12 x 2.91 in
              +) Rectangle: 
                                → Overall size: 8.4 x 9.7 cm ~ 3.31 x 3.82 in 
                                → Inner photo size: 4 x 5.7 cm ~ 1.57 x 2.24 in
              +) Oval 2 (Style 1 and Style 2): 
                                → Overall size: 8.5 x 11.5 cm ~ 3.35 x 4.53 in
                                → Inner photo size: 4.7 x 5.7 cm ~ 1.85 x 2.24 in
              +) Shield:
                                → Overall size: 8.3 x 11.6 cm ~ 3.27 x 4.57 in
                                → Inner photo size: 4.7 x 6.9 cm ~ 1.85 x 2.71 in
    - Gold iron stand size: 8.4 x 10.5 cm ~ 3.31 x 4.13 in
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - 1-sided printing is applied on the paper insert inside the frame.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a photo frame magnet and a tabletop decorative display.
    - Magnetic backing allows the frame to attach easily to refrigerators, lockers, cabinets, and other magnetic surfaces.
    - Includes a gold iron stand for displaying the frame on desks, shelves, countertops, or memory corners.
    - Compact and lightweight design makes it easy to place anywhere without taking up much space.
    - Perfect for showcasing treasured memories in a stylish vintage-inspired format.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for pet lovers, vintage décor lovers, and anyone who enjoys personalized keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for memorial moments, family photos, and decorative display collections.
    - Great for home décor, office desks, kitchen displays, and sentimental gift giving.
    - Adds a classic, elegant, and personal touch to any space 🎁
     

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Vintage Photo Frame Magnet

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
